data.action: 身穿居家T恤系粉色围裙双手递出便当盒，脸颊泛红偏头傲娇娇嗔
data.camera: medium shot, eye level, domestic warmth
data.description: 【惣流·明日香 · 居家围裙做便当的傲娇早晨】公寓温馨整洁的厨房料理台前，晨光透过窗台照亮了冒着热气的煎蛋卷。明日香身穿简单的居家短袖T恤，外罩一件带着荷叶边的粉红色围裙。她微红着脸偏过头，双手将一个精心制作、摆放得整整齐齐的双层爱心便当盒递到你面前，长双马尾轻晃，傲娇又娇嗔地大声嘱咐——「看、看什么看！本小姐只是碰巧做多了而已！必须全部给我吃光，要是敢剩下一颗米粒就绝对不轻饶你！」
data.lighting: 厨房窗户透进的明亮柔和晨曦光斑与料理台温润木色
data.location: 公寓明亮家庭厨房料理台前
data.promptProse: Asuka stands at the apartment kitchen counter in a home T-shirt and pink ruffled apron, turning her flushed face aside while offering the carefully arranged double-layer bento with both hands. Her red clips remain beside lightly moving twin tails. In the eye-level medium view, the bento overlaps the near worktop, steaming rolled egg rests farther back, and the counter turns beneath the kitchen window toward closed cupboards. Bright morning light catches the food compartments and apron frills. The window frame casts a soft stripe across the farther counter; warm wood reflection reaches her shaded wrists while the cupboard recesses remain subdued.
data.title: 惣流·明日香 · 居家围裙做便当的傲娇早晨
